SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE TABLE [BNKM].[ChannelTransaction]
( 
	CustomerAccountId	varchar(40)	NOT NULL	,
	TransactionTimestamp	varchar(14)	NULL	,
	ATMBankID	varchar(11)	NULL	,
	ATMTerminalID	varchar(20)	NULL	,
	Command	varchar(4)	NULL	,
	Stan	varchar(12)	NULL	,
	TransactionId	varchar(9)	NOT NULL	,
	TransactionDate	date	NOT NULL	,
	TranParticularNum	varchar(3)	NOT NULL	,
	TranParticularIndicator	char(1)	NULL	,
	TranParticularRemittance	varchar(30)	NULL	,
	TranParticularPart1	varchar(50)	NULL	,
	TranParticularPart2	varchar(50)	NULL	,
	TransactionAmount	decimal(20,4)	NULL	,
	SourceAPPCode	varchar(50)	NULL	,
	ATMCardID	varchar(28)	NULL	,
	BillerCode	varchar(20)	NULL	,
	BillerSubrNum1	varchar(40)	NULL	,
	BillerSubrNum2	varchar(40)	NULL	,
	AtmTransactionNote1	varchar(50)	NULL	,
	AtmTransactionNote2	varchar(50)	NULL	,
	AtmTransactionNote3	varchar(50)	NULL	,
	AtmTransactionNote4	varchar(50)	NULL	,
	AtmTransactionNote5	varchar(50)	NULL	,
	TPSUser	varchar(80)	NULL	,
	TPSTranRef	varchar(80)	NULL	,
	TPSAccountNum	varchar(20)	NULL	,
	TPSAccountName	varchar(80)	NULL	,
	TPSTranRemarks	varchar(80)	NULL	,
	TPSTranDesc	varchar(80)	NULL	,
	FinancialInstitutionId	varchar(8)	NULL	,
	SourceSystemCode	varchar(50)	NULL	,
	WorkFlowId	bigint	NULL	,
	TaskRunId	bigint	NULL	,
	InsertDttm	datetime	NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
)
GO
